totals.processingShareNote: process inclusive is the whole processing call, not the geometry timer. Process-total counts also include three preparatory index scans, startup, output, final metadata and teardown. No phase markers were enabled.

method.selfCostExtraction: Resolved fn/cfn compressed identifiers; sum non-call cost lines by function name; calls= costs excluded from self sum; incoming call counts aggregated from calls= records. Function-name aggregation combines source-line attribution for inlined code. Self sums exactly match summary/totals on each arm.
limitations: Existing annotations use inclusive=yes: nested rows must not be added. ProductOwner::epoch inclusive 366737538 Ir is mostly geometry underneath it, not epoch overhead.
No cache events, cycle counts, branch miss events, native lock waits, atomic latency or memory-stall data were recorded. Empty cache descriptions are not zero misses.

Names and line attribution change under inlining/LTO. Missing out-of-line function or mutex symbol does not prove zero invocations. Unknown address symbols must not be matched across binaries as if they were stable identities.
One base run then one branch run; single-thread Valgrind execution is not native timing. The instrumented 5866ms vs 5843ms totals do not waive native regression.
Counts reflect this single FZK execution only. No Holter or browser attribution exists here.

scope: Single-threaded Callgrind on original source-bound native binaries. Instruction counts are not parallel elapsed time.
interpretation: Additional checks, processor sweeps and epoch allocations are measured; their instruction cost does not establish the cause of the original wall-clock slowdown.
